RateLimiting._comment: Per-OrganizationId token bucket (XD01-214) — mitigates one tenant's burst traffic (e.g. a batch mobile photo upload) degrading others sharing the same clusters. TokenLimit is the bucket's max size; TokensPerPeriod tokens are added back every ReplenishmentPeriodSeconds. OrganizationIdClaimType is unset by default (every caller shares one bucket) until an operator's CIAM tenant emits a real organization claim — set it to that claim's type.
